evidence: Run on 2026-10-16 through the proxy, in two fresh sessions. Session 1 (variant A) went from checkout.headspace.com/checkout through the quiz, the plan picker and Continue to the Auth0 Create-account page on auth.headspace.com, then 'Log in', the identifier-first sign-in, and back to the payment step. There the cardholder name, country, state, postcode, expiry selects, card number and CVV were filled inside the Zuora hosted payment frame #z_hppm_iframe. The proxy answered with a verification-only test card, and no field showed aria-invalid afterwards. Session 2 (variant B) proved the inline sign-in on checkout.headspace.com: after submit, #z_hppm_iframe appeared and the card number and CVV inputs counted visible. Pay ('Complete') was NOT clicked: every plan is a free trial, $0 today, and the card is charged when the trial ends.
gotchas: 2026-10-16: Every plan (Annual, Monthly) is a free trial, $0 today, with the card charged when the trial ends. 'Complete' starts a subscription that bills later, so it is the account owner's to click; this recipe does not click it and no decline was observed.

2026-10-16: /checkout is A/B tested after Skip. Variant B shows the plan picker with an inline Sign up form, and 'Log in' swaps in the inline login (#email-input, #password-input). Variant A shows the plan picker with a single Continue button, which leads to an Auth0 'Create your account' page on auth.headspace.com; its 'Log in' link goes to an identifier-first form: email input[name="username"][type="email"], tick input[type="checkbox"], button[type="submit"], then input[name="password"] and button[type="submit"]. That sign-in returns to /checkout at the payment step.
2026-10-16: Tick the Terms checkbox before submitting either login form. Inline: input[type="checkbox"][aria-label="Terms and Conditions"]. Auth0: the page's only input[type="checkbox"].
2026-10-16: An exit-intent 'Get 40% off' dialog can open over the quiz and swallow clicks. Press Escape on [role="dialog"] button to close it, then click again.

2026-10-16: Fill the Zuora billing fields (cardholder name from full_name, country select from the address country token, state, postcode) and the expiry selects ('01'-style month, four-digit year) in calls before the card number. Then fill #input-creditCardNumber and #input-cardSecurityCode back to back, all with frame #z_hppm_iframe.
2026-10-16: The proxy reports a reCAPTCHA (recaptcha.net) on the payment page, apparently Zuora's invisible check. It did not block filling; whether it challenges at 'Complete' is unknown.
2026-10-16: In variant A the plan buttons and Continue had no selector this run could prove (button:has-text("Monthly plan") never resolved). The default plan is Annual.
